decision: branched prerelease/solid-2 off main and committed the dirty tree's vite-plus work first
why: main's working tree was dirty; separating it keeps the migration diff readable

decision: read the real .d.ts of solid-js 2.0.0-rc.3 and @solidjs/universal 2.0.0-rc.0 instead of trusting the migration guide
why: the guide is prose; the shipped types are the contract
result: confirmed createResource, splitProps, mergeProps, Suspense, ErrorBoundary, Index, SuspenseList all gone

decision: keeping the requested pairing of solid-js rc.3 with @solidjs/universal rc.0
why: universal rc.0 only imports createMemo, createRenderEffect, createComponent, merge, createRoot, untrack, runWithOwner, flatten, flush from solid-js, and rc.3 still exports every one

decision: renderer contract changed: effect and createRenderEffect now take (compute, apply), use is replaced by applyRef and ref, spread gained skipChildren
why: these are the pieces runtime.tsx is built on, so the renderer glue is a rewrite not a rename

decision: rigor set high: build a real test harness before touching source, and baseline it against the Solid 1 code
why: public library, major version, zero existing tests, and the renderer glue rides on runtime contracts a typecheck cannot see

decision: probe says the whole pixi scene graph runs headless in node, no canvas needed
why: means the bulk of the harness is a fast plain node suite; only Application needs a real renderer
evidence: Container, addChildAt, removeFromParent, Text mutate, Graphics, setSize all constructed and mutated fine under node 24

decision: found a latent bug while probing: runtime.tsx builds text with the deprecated new Text(value) form
why: pixi v8 warns on it; the migration is the moment to fix it

decision: compile the tests with universal generate pointed at solid-pixi, not dom generate
why: it exercises solid-pixi's own createComponent/insert/spread/setProp codegen path, which is exactly the surface this migration changes
evidence: '@solidjs/universal README, runtime.tsx already exports the v1 universal export set

decision: wrote 13 scene-graph tests and got them green on solid-js 1.9 before touching any source
why: gives the migration an old-value/new-value check instead of assertions written to fit whatever Solid 2 does

decision: vitest was loading solid-js's server build, so every signal write was a no-op
why: found it with a bare createSignal probe rather than guessing at the 5 failing tests

decision: pinned 'dispose leaves nodes attached to the root' as its own test instead of asserting the tidy behaviour
why: that is what Solid 1 actually does; if rc.0 changes it I want a red test and a deliberate call, not a silent difference

decision: no coverage for the four use* asset hooks
why: Assets.load needs fetch and image decoding, too heavy for the node harness
